fictionNotice: Every firearm in this archive is a fictional MAGIARCHY design. Named real-world firearms are visual and conceptual references only, not licensed copies or products that exist inside the story world.

manufacturer.name: Ren Arms
manufacturer.description: An established Narvean firearms manufacturer based in Rennel, the Ducal capital.
manufacturer.namingTradition: Its pistol models traditionally carry bird nicknames. Each bird broadly corresponds to the physical character, size, role, and perceived personality of the pistol.

weapons.imageAlt: Side profile illustration of the silver and dark Ren L17 Sparrow pistol
weapons.storyUse: Standard-issued pistol for every MSF officer who has passed weapons certification. MSF purchases the Sparrow from Ren Arms and does not manufacture firearms.
weapons.designSummary: A slim, compact, silver-finished pistol with an elegant and deliberately understated appearance. Its proportions sit conceptually between the Walther PPK and SIG Sauer P230, slightly more elongated and graceful than a PPK while retaining enough visual weight to avoid looking fragile.
characteristics: Exposed hammer and small conventional sights
Dark grip panels contrasting with silver metal
Smooth exterior surfaces and restrained controls
Designed for personnel who carry it far more often than they fire it
weapons.finishNote: The silver finish belongs to the firearm itself rather than to an MSF customization. Routine issue gradually makes the ordinary Ren Arms product visually associated with MSF officers.
weapons.nameMeaning: Its small size, light visual presence, discretion, and modest chambering.

characterLinks.name: Lynleit
characterLinks.note: Carries the issued Sparrow as her personal sidearm.

weapons.familyPosition: Larger, louder, and heavier relative of the Sparrow
weapons.designSummary: An enlarged and strengthened development of the Sparrow for the more powerful 9×19 cartridge. It retains the older Ren Arms family line while becoming thicker, heavier, visually denser, and more assertive.
characteristics: Graceful slide profile and exposed hammer
Recognizably Ren Arms grip and frame lines
weapons.finishNote: It fills the space between a discreet institutional pistol and a full modern duty handgun.
weapons.nameMeaning: Its close relationship to the Sparrow, with a larger, louder, heavier, and more noticeable character.

weapons.designSummary: Ren Arms moving from its older elegant metal-pistol tradition toward a modern service-pistol philosophy. The Rook is thicker and squarer than the Sparrow and Magpie, primarily utilitarian, and sized to bridge concealed, bodyguard, and ordinary duty work.
characteristics: Restrained modern styling without excessive decorative machining
weapons.finishNote: The dependable all-purpose compact of the current family.
weapons.nameMeaning: A sturdy, practical, intelligent, common bird with considerably more substance than a Sparrow.

weapons.designSummary: The full-size workhorse of the modern Ren Arms pistol family. It shares the Rook's language but gains a longer slide, taller grip, greater mass, and a conventional full-size duty silhouette.
characteristics: Longer slide and taller grip than the Rook
Grip more sculpted and ergonomic than a strongly blocky form
Intended to feel ubiquitous in police, military, security, and state service
weapons.finishNote: It is neither prestigious nor exotic. It is a serious, reliable, full-size service pistol.
weapons.nameMeaning: Its common, capable, dark, and practical character.

weapons.role: Premium or specialist full-size service pistol
weapons.designSummary: A refined, specialist-oriented relative of the Crow in roughly the same size class. It should feel heavier, more deliberate, more sophisticated, and more purposeful without becoming flashy.
characteristics: Refined machining and clean sight lines
weapons.finishNote: Suited to specialist officers, firearms instructors, protective personnel, or individuals who deliberately select and care about their sidearm. Future premium-frame variants remain undefined.
weapons.nameMeaning: A larger, darker, more threatening, and more prestigious character than the Rook or Crow.

weapons.role: Long-slide precision, prestige, or specialist pistol
weapons.familyPosition: Longest and most refined specialist pistol
weapons.designSummary: The longest and most visually graceful pistol in the current Ren Arms family. Its proportions are stretched rather than bulky, placing it between a precision service pistol, prestige officer's sidearm, specialist handgun, and serious sporting or competition-derived pistol.
weapons.finishNote: Physically large without looking brutal. It is not intended as an ordinary standard-issued sidearm.
weapons.nameMeaning: Size, length, grace, refinement, and composure rather than threat. A Raven should look dangerous; a Swan should look elegant and controlled.
references: Refined SIG Sauer and Walther proportions
